text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The Slovak agriculture ministry said it did not expect significant increase in food prices next year. The ministry said that prices of poultry and bakery products should decrease in 1997.
- Major Slovak shoe producer JAS Bardejov said it would produce about three million pairs of shoes this year, compared with the originally planed 3.7 million pairs.

PRAVDA - President Michal Kovac firmly rejected allegations that he had paid one million schillings for the testimony of a former agent of the secret service (SIS), who accused the SIS of kidnapping the president's son. Kovac said the allegation, presented in a documentary broadcasted by the official Slovak Television last week, was a part of the a campaign to discredit him.

NARODNA OBRODA - Slovakia's sole shipbuilder Slovenske Lodenice has completed more than 50 river and maritime cargo vessels worth over 500 million marks since the start of cooperation with Germany's Wessels in 1991.
